props_refinement.prompt:
Edit the FIRST image (nine-object transparent production prop atlas). SECOND image is the exact visual style reference, particularly the little yellow submarine, salvage gear, rocks, sushi plates and plant within that reference. Change ONLY the artistic style and submarine proportions of image1 to faithfully match the hand-drawn game in image2. Preserve the nine object identities, 3x3 layout/order, transparent empty space, and completeness of each object. Image2 is style guidance; do NOT reproduce its background, UI, text or title.

Critical corrections: simplify to confident thick slightly irregular very dark brown ink outlines and broad flat gouache fills with only restrained mottled paper grain and a little hatching. Eliminate the dense etched scratches, photorealistic plating, dozens of tiny rivets, noisy microtextures and elaborate steampunk detail. At phone scale the shapes must be cheerful and clear, almost storybook doodles but textured and warm rather than SVG. Follow the actual reference closely.
SUBMARINE top-left: match reference's cute squat oval yellow top-down sub with rounded nose toward TOP, small flat headlamp cap, ONE blue circular window, grey rounded rear hatch with2black slits, compact side fins/tanks and a tiny rear propeller. Remove the pointed rocket nose, long slender profile, ornate pipes and heavy plate seams. Dark thick contour like reference, mustard yellow broad fill, a few delicate scuffs. Full silhouette.
GEAR top-middle: simple eight-tooth mustard brass gear with a dark circular center hole, broad uneven dark outline and very few scratches.
ROCK top-right: stylized blue-grey angular rock with4or5simple planes and ink cracks, no detailed photo barnacles.
CHAIR middle-left: simple warm wooden guest chair like reference, broad handpainted planes, dark ink edge, no dense wood grain.
PLANT middle-center: simple pointed sage leaves and tan terracotta pot like reference, broad confident strokes.
ALL FOUR SUSHI DISHES: warm handdrawn doodle plates as in reference, flatter chunky rice shapes with a few short marks, coral salmon stripes, dark smooth nori, cream porcelain. Remove photoreal food gloss and individual rice-grain rendering; use painterly simplified food illustrations.
No scenery, no background, no labels, no dividers. Preserve true alpha transparency. Keep each of the nine sprites fully inside its own cell with empty separation.

creatures_refinement.prompt:
Edit FIRST image (transparent six-sprite underwater atlas). SECOND image is the exact accepted style reference. Preserve all six object identities and their original3columns by2rows placement, complete silhouettes and genuine alpha transparency. Change ONLY rendering style to faithfully match the thick outlined charming hand-painted doodle game in second image.

The current atlas is too anatomically realistic, too finely etched and too mottled at small mobile size. Simplify it into clear chunky shapes with strong slightly irregular very dark ink outlines, broad teal/coral/sage gouache fills, sparse inner linework and restrained quiet paper grain. Fewer microscopic skin scales, scratches and specular marks. NO vector-clean geometry: preserve handpainted charm. Reference's rocks/kelp/coral along the ocean canyon show the exact desired amount of paint shading and detail. Creatures should be friendly game critters, not scientific specimen illustrations.
TOP LEFT: plump rounded coral salmon facing left, simple fins, one round dark eye, a few irregular soft spots, broad cream belly.
TOP CENTER: cute curled coral shrimp facing left, simplified segments, two readable antennae, just a few short little legs and round dark eye.
TOP RIGHT: friendly sinuous sage eel facing left, warm cream belly stripe, one smooth thick dorsal fin and playful curve; simple eye and mouth, no scale engraving.
BOTTOM LEFT: dark teal broad kelp fronds with thick irregular outlines and just one simple lighter vein per leaf.
BOTTOM CENTER: coral-pink branching coral and a few sage plants on a simple rock base, restrained handpainted shade.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the same cyan oval portal between two stylized blue-grey rocks; simplify cracks and barnacles, keep soft luminous spiral and no hard rectangular backing.
Keep all objects complete inside their cells with transparent gutters. Do NOT copy the reference's scenery, UI, text or title. No labels. Background remains entirely transparent; no solid fill or checkerboard.
